deadline.value: March 1 for admission and full funding consideration.
deadline.quote: For admission and full funding consideration, please have your application completed by March 1st. Most decisions will be released by April 1st.

gre_general.value: All applicants must submit Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores.
gre_general.quote: All applicants must submit Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Biomedical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: An approved faculty member who agrees to be the student's Ph.D. advisor is required before application is considered.
supervisor.quote: An approved faculty member who agrees to be the student's Ph.D. advisor. The student must contact the faculty member with whom they want to work and obtain this approval before their application is considered for admission.

funding.value: Applications completed by March 1 receive full funding consideration.
funding.quote: For admission and full funding consideration, please have your application completed by March 1st. Most decisions will be released by April 1st.

entry_route.value: A GPA of at least 3.5 in Bachelor's degree or 3.3 in Master's degree is required.
entry_route.quote: A GPA of at least 3.5/4.0 in the applicant's Bachelor's degree or a GPA of at least 3.3/4.0 in the applicant's Master's degree is required.
